findings.title: Narrow sidebar resize retained focus on mobile-only Close
findings.method: simulated DOM plus CSS visibility source inspection
reproduce: Open navigation, which focuses its Close button.
findings.observed_before_fix: syncSidebar removed the drawer state but did not move focus from a Close button hidden by desktop CSS.
findings.expected: Focus moves to a visible logical control when the active panel control becomes hidden.
findings.repair: Author captured focus before media-query sync and restores the navigation toggle for hidden panels or mobile-only Close.
findings.retest_result: pass in simulated DOM; real responsive browser behavior remains unverified
